record.description_evidence:
Create a resume in minutes with the ai resume creator. Browse 100+ professional resume templates. Quick & Easy to Use.

Are you looking for professional resume templates?
This resume creator has over 100 resume templates and is editable. Choose a resume template that you like, edit it, and export it. It's that simple.

Professional Resume Creator
Design professional resumes in just a few taps with professional resume templates. 

CV Maker
CV Maker App is a user-friendly mobile application designed to assist individuals in creating professional and impactful resumes or curriculum vitae (CV). With its intuitive interface and robust features, the app simplifies the process of crafting a well-structured and visually appealing CV, enabling users to present their skills, experiences, and qualifications effectively.

Resume Creator
With the Resume Creator, users can input their personal information, including contact details, educational background, work experience, skills, and achievements. The application organizes and formats this information automatically, ensuring a well-structured and visually appealing resume.

One of the key features of the Resume Creator is its vast collection of pre-designed resume templates. These resume templates are professionally crafted and cater to various industries and job positions, enabling users to choose the one that best suits their needs. The resume templates provide a cohesive layout and design, ensuring consistency and enhancing the visual appeal of the resume.

Resume Creator
Resume Creator allows users to export their resumes in various formats, such as PDFs. This makes it convenient to share the resume digitally, submit it online, or print it for physical applications.

If you choose to subscribe to any of the “Resume Creator PRO” Subscriptions, the payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. any unused portion of the free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription to that publication. From that moment and further, the subscription automatically renews until auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your account settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active period. If you have any questions while using this app, please contact us via email at info@optimumbrew.com.

Tired of applying to dozens of jobs and hearing nothing back?

The problem isn't your experience. It's your resume getting filtered out before a human ever reads it.

Rexu uses advanced AI to build, tailor, and score your resume so it gets past Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) — and into the hands of the hiring manager.

WHAT REXU DOES

Paste a job description. Rexu rewrites your resume in seconds to match the exact keywords, tone, and skills the role requires. No manual editing. No guesswork.

KEY FEATURES

AI Resume Tailoring: Match your resume to any job posting instantly. Our AI identifies the keywords and phrases employers are screening for — and weaves them in naturally.
Real-Time ATS Scoring: See your ATS score before you apply. Get specific, actionable suggestions to increase your chances of passing automated screening filters.
Cover Letter Generator: Never stare at a blank page again. Generate a tailored, professional cover letter that matches your resume and the job in one tap.
Professional PDF Export: Download a beautifully formatted, recruiter-ready PDF instantly. Every template is designed to be both ATS-readable and visually polished.
Modern Resume Templates: Choose from designer-crafted layouts that are clean, professional, and tested across all major ATS systems.
Cross-Device Sync: Start on your iPhone. Continue on the web. Your resumes stay in sync everywhere via your secure account.
SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED

Rexu is a premium service. An active auto-renewing subscription is required to access the app's features, including AI resume generation, cover letters, and PDF exports.

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
YOUR DATA IS SAFE

Your resume content belongs to you. We never sell your data or use it to train public AI models. All processing is secured and encrypted end-to-end.

Land more interviews. Apply with confidence. Download Rexu today.

Whether you’re applying for your first job, changing careers, or updating your existing resume, you can create a polished, job-ready resume without spending hours writing and formatting.

PROFESSIONAL RESUME TEMPLATES

Choose from professionally designed resume templates created for different careers, industries, and experience levels.

• Modern and professional resume designs
• Multiple styles and layouts
• High-quality typography and vector graphics
• Clean, polished PDF documents
• Easy switching between templates without re-entering your information

AI RESUME BUILDER

Build your resume faster with AI-powered tools designed to help throughout the entire process.

Use AI to:
• Import information and create your profile
• Improve existing resume content
• Generate professional work experience descriptions
• Create content for sections that need more detail
• Turn your ideas into clear, concise resume text
• Add information using your voice

SMART RESUME EDITOR

Complete your resume step by step with a simple, structured profile editor.

Add and manage:
• Professional summary
• Contact information
• Skills
• Languages
• Education
• Work experience
• Websites and links
• Hobbies
• Additional sections

See the completion progress for each section, so you always know what’s finished and what still needs your attention.

VOICE INPUT WITH AI

Creating a resume doesn’t have to mean typing everything manually.

Describe your experience, education, skills, or other information using your voice. AI helps turn your input into structured content that you can review, edit, and add to your resume.

WRITE & IMPROVE WITH AI

Not sure how to describe your experience?

Generate professional descriptions with AI or improve text you’ve already written. Make your resume clearer, more concise, and easier for employers to understand.

PREVIEW YOUR RESUME

See how your resume looks while you’re building it. Switch between templates and find the design that works best for your experience and style.

EXPORT TO PDF

Export your finished resume as a high-quality PDF that’s ready for job applications.

Use your resume to:
• Apply for jobs
• Send it to recruiters and employers
• Attach it to online applications
• Share it through email or messaging apps
• Save it as a professional PDF

FROM PROFILE TO FINISHED RESUME

Choose a template, complete your profile, create and improve your content with AI, preview your resume, and export a professional PDF when you’re ready.

Create your resume and get ready for your next opportunity.

CV Engineer helps you create ATS-friendly resumes, improve them with AI, and check them for common mistakes before applying for jobs.

HOW IT WORKS
Getting started is easy. Choose a professional CV template and then fill it with your information. That's it! We provide examples to help you.

Our resume creator is perfect for students, graduates, career changers, professionals, and job seekers in every industry.

Our CV templates were designed by a recruiter to be ATS-friendly. They’re optimized for Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) used by employers. Create resumes that are easy for hiring managers and recruitment software to read.

Use our resume checker to identify common mistakes before you apply. Resume Scan analyzes your CV and provides actionable feedback to improve readability, professionalism, and ATS compatibility.

Resume Scan helps identify issues that could reduce your chances of getting job interviews.

* AI RESUME WRITING ASSISTANT
Improve your CV with AI-powered suggestions. Rewrite work experience, personal statements, and skills to sound more professional. Includes spelling and grammar correction.

* IMPORT YOUR EXISTING RESUME
Import an existing resume from PDF or Word in seconds and continue editing it inside our CV maker.

* EASY RESUME EDITING OPTIONS AND CV WRITING TOOLS
Quickly write and edit your CV. Our resume builder handles the formatting. Use bullet points to present your experience in an easy-to-read format.

* CREATE CUSTOM CV SECTIONS
Add sections to your resume with custom titles. Perfect if you have experience that doesn’t fit into traditional CV sections.

* STEP-BY-STEP ADVICE ON HOW TO WRITE EACH RESUME SECTION
Advice from a professional recruiter on how to write each section of your CV. Make your resume easy-to-read for hiring managers.

* EXAMPLE CV SECTIONS TO GIVE YOU IDEAS
Looking for inspiration? We have examples to give you ideas on what to include.

Example resume sections for healthcare professionals, nurses, construction workers, data scientists, software developers, students, graduates, executives, and sales managers. Our intelligent resume creator can help regardless of your profession!

* DOWNLOAD AND SHARE YOUR NEW PDF RESUME
Easily download and share your CV in PDF format. Save to your device or share as an email attachment. Send your curriculum vitae to your contacts for feedback.

* WRITE YOUR RESUME IN ANOTHER LANGUAGE
Our resume editor supports English, Spanish, Dutch, German, French, Indonesian, Italian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, and Turkish.

* OTHER FEATURES
- Dark mode
- Edit font sizes and margins on your CV
- Add your photo to your CV
- Job search
- Resignation letter maker

CV Engineer makes it easy to create resumes. Our resume builder produces a professional curriculum vitae using your choice of template.

CV Engineer was created by a professional recruiter to help job seekers build better resumes and get more interviews.

Our resume maker has all the features you need to create a CV that hiring managers can easily read.

CV ENGINEER IN THE PRESS
Our free CV generator has been featured by Wired, CNET, and Popular Science.

FEEDBACK AND CUSTOMER SUPPORT
Want to give feedback on our resume maker? Email us at info@cvengineer.io

Another job post, another resume version, another round of guessing which words will get noticed. AI Resume Tailor turns your existing resume and a job description into a focused, role-specific resume you can review, fact-check, and export.

When you are applying to multiple jobs, rewriting the same experience over and over gets old fast. You need the language of the role without inventing experience, a clear view of
what changed, and a clean file you can actually submit. AI Resume Tailor takes that busywork off your plate.

TAILOR YOUR RESUME TO THE JOB

• Upload a PDF, DOCX, or TXT resume
• Paste resume text when you do not have a file handy
• Paste the job description you are targeting
• Reuse your saved master resume for faster future rewrites
• Get a polished resume written for that specific role

SEE WHY THE REWRITE FITS

• Compare role keywords in your original and tailored resume
• See which job terms were added or surfaced
• Review missing role terms before you submit
• Check ATS and formatting risks
• View the target role and company when available

STAY IN CONTROL

• Compare the original and tailored resumes side by side
• Review tracked changes with clear explanations
• Mark changes as accepted or flagged
• Verify possible new metrics, credentials, or claims before export
• Avoid blindly submitting AI copy without reviewing it first

EXPORT AND KEEP MOVING

• Export as PDF for polished applications
• Export as editable RTF for Word-compatible editing
• Export as TXT or copy plain text for online forms
• Save tailored versions in your resume history
• Rewrite for another job without starting from scratch

BUILT FOR REAL JOB SEARCHES

• Active job seekers applying to multiple roles
• Career changers repositioning their experience
• Students and recent graduates building stronger applications
• Professionals who need sharper, job-specific wording
• Applicants filling out Workday, Greenhouse, and other online forms
• Non-native English speakers who want clearer resume phrasing

CREDITS

Your first rewrite is free. After that, one credit creates one tailored resume. Credits are available as one-time in-app purchases, never expire, and do not require a
subscription.

Stop sending the same generic resume to every opening. Download AI Resume Tailor and turn each job post into a stronger, more focused application.
